FloPlast gutter brushes are efficient gutter clearing tools designed to keep roof drainage systems free from obstructions. These durable brushes effectively prevent the build-up of common debris such as moss, leaves, and twigs, which can cause blockages and water damage to properties. Installation is straightforward and they require minimal maintenance, making them ideal for homeowners and property managers seeking reliable gutter protection. The flexible design ensures these 105mm brushes adapt to virtually any standard guttering system, providing a robust solution for year-round debris management. Supplied in card/paper packaging suitable for kerbside recycling.
